rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: ProShares UltraPro QQQ (3x Nasdaq-100)
positions.catalyst: Broad risk-on Monday to open the biggest megacap-earnings week of the quarter. Premarket: Nasdaq-100 +1.62%, S&P +0.96%, Dow +1.01%, Russell +1.29%; oil tumbling (macro tailwind). Semiconductor leadership is the standout — memory/HBM surge with SK hynix, Micron (MU +2.0% premkt) and Sandisk rallying; SOXS inverse -6.7% confirms broad semi strength. Amazon, Meta and Microsoft report Wed/Thu and Apple Thu after close — a week of forward catalysts for the Nasdaq megacaps that dominate QQQ.
positions.driver: LONG 3x Nasdaq-100. Chose TQQQ over SOXL (3x semis, the higher-octane runner-up) because SOXL was already +6.6% in premarket — approaching the no-chase zone with the highest single-sector concentration/vol — whereas TQQQ at +4.1% premarket is less extended and far broader (holds NVDA/AVGO plus every megacap reporting this week), giving more downside protection for a 100% all-in hold. 3x leverage justified by the strong multi-factor fresh catalyst (broad risk-on breadth + semi memory surge + imminent megacap prints). Also weighed MU 2x single-stock (too concentrated ahead of peers' earnings) and staying in cash (edge is clearly positive today, not a low-edge day). Hard stop 59.97 (-10%, 3x rule).
positions.risks: 3x daily-reset ETF — decay and gap risk; a risk-off reversal or a single disappointing megacap guide (AMZN/META/MSFT Wed-Thu, AAPL Thu) can whip the Nasdaq and hit 3x exposure three times as hard. All-in single instrument = no diversification. a premarket open-and-fade would erode the gap. Semi leadership is momentum-driven and can rotate.
